page_title: LAZ 1-0 JUV | Lazio v Juventus 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+4' What a save from Ivan Provedel! Khephren Thuram (Juventus) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
90+4' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
90+3' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
90+1' The foul by Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Andrea Colombo.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Francisco Conceicao (Juventus). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
89' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) whips in a cross from the corner, but Ivan Provedel is well positioned and punches the ball away.
88' Joao Mario (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball is out of play and Juventus manage to earn a corner.
88' The free kick is delivered by Filip Kostic (Juventus) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
87' Adam Marusic (Lazio) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
86' Here comes a substitution. Federico Gatti is given a rest as he is replaced by Joao Mario (Juventus).
84' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul.
83' That was close by Pedro (Lazio)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
83' The referee allows time for a substitution. Gustav Isaksen will be replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
82' Here is a change. Boulaye Dia is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).
81' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

81' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lazio are going to take it.
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.
80' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Lazio will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
79' CLOSE! Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post!
78' A substitution has been made. Weston McKennie is replaced by Lois Openda (Juventus).
76' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Filip Kostic (Juventus) sends it out of play.
76' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Juventus earn a corner.
75' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the right side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
75' Now Juventus have a corner.
75' A cross into the box from Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) is cleared.
74' An attempted cross from Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) is cleared.
71' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post.
69' Weston McKennie (Juventus) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
68' Toma Basic (Lazio) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Matias Vecino comes onto the pitch to replace him.
66' Igor Tudor prepares a substitution. Teun Koopmeiners is replaced by Khephren Thuram (Juventus).
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Filip Kostic (Juventus) is coming onto the pitch as Jonathan David cannot continue after picking up an injury.
65' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Mattia Perin is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
64' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) for his blatant foul.
64' Jonathan David (Juventus) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
62' Toma Basic (Lazio) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Mattia Perin is prepared to thwart his effort.
62' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Juventus! Play can continue.

61' Play continues despite the shouts by some Juventus players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Andrea Colombo interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
60' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
60' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
60' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
58' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar.
55' Andrea Colombo has a clear sight and sees a foul from Adam Marusic (Lazio).
54' Andrea Colombo rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Weston McKennie (Juventus).
54' Substitution. Manuel Lazzari leaves the pitch and is replaced by Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
52' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
52' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) makes a strong challenge and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
50' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
49' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andrea Colombo has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
48' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Ivan Provedel makes a save.
47' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
46' Igor Tudor has made a change at the break. Kenan Yildiz has come on in place of Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' A corner kick by Juventus is thwarted by the well prepared Ivan Provedel (Lazio).
45+1' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall. The ball is out of play. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) brings his opponent down. Andrea Colombo has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
42' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is caught offside!
41' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) is penalised for holding. Andrea Colombo signals a set piece.
41' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is able to continue to play.
40' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) picks up an injury.
39' A lofted pass into the box is met by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post.
38' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle after Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
37' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) commits a foul and Andrea Colombo immediately signals a free kick.
36' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
34' Jonathan David (Juventus) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Ivan Provedel makes a great save.
33' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) sees a yellow card from Andrea Colombo after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
33' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
32' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
32' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
32' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
30' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) has tested the patience of referee Andrea Colombo and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
28' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
26' The ratio of the ball possession is 37:63.
23' Weston McKennie (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but Ivan Provedel comes off his line to gather the ball.
22' The cross fools the defence and leaves Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the left post.
20' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Weston McKennie (Juventus) commits a rough foul. Andrea Colombo stops the game and makes a call.
17' Weston McKennie (Juventus) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
16' A spell of possession for Juventus in an attempt to control the game.
13' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
12' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him.
9' 1 - 0 Goal! Danilo Cataldi passes the ball to Toma Basic (Lazio) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Mattia Perin couldn't do anything about it. 1:0.
8' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
6' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Foul! Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
4' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Juventus will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Andrea Colombo.
